items.maxMeters: number, inclusive upper bound in metres

items.amount: number in THB per operator entry

BTS.name: BTS Skytrain
BTS.notes: The operator publishes a fare matrix, but reuse terms for the table are not stated here; excluded pending review. BTS Gold Line also needs a separate official table.

BEM_MRT_BLUE.name: MRT Blue Line (BEM)
BEM_MRT_BLUE.notes: Official fare information is published, but reuse terms for the tariff table are unclear; excluded pending review.

MRTA_PURPLE.name: MRT Purple Line (MRTA/BEM)
MRTA_PURPLE.notes: MRTA publishes ticket and fare information, but reuse terms for the tariff table are unclear; excluded pending review. A 40 THB daily cap was announced for Dec 2025–Nov 2026 and is not computed.

ARL.name: Airport Rail Link
ARL.notes: AERA 1 is the operator. No current official fare table with clear reuse terms was confirmed; excluded pending review.

MRT_YELLOW.name: MRT Yellow Line (EBM)
MRT_YELLOW.notes: EBM publishes an official fare matrix, but reuse terms for the tariff table are unclear; excluded pending review.

MRT_PINK.name: MRT Pink Line (NBM)
MRT_PINK.notes: NBM publishes fare information, but reuse terms and the currently applicable full table were not confirmed; excluded pending review.

SRT_RED.name: SRT Red Line (SRTET)
SRT_RED.notes: SRTET publishes an official fare matrix, but reuse terms for the tariff table are unclear; excluded pending review. MRTA announced a 40 THB daily cap for Dec 2025–Nov 2026 and it is not computed.

BTS_GOLD.name: BTS Gold Line
BTS_GOLD.notes: BTS publishes a flat fare on the Gold Line profile, but no separately reusable current fare table was confirmed; excluded pending review.

current.description: Each operator charges separately. Transfers between operators start a separate fare; published caps and discounts are not calculated.

common-2027.description: Configurable placeholder only. A single-entry common-fare policy and calculation rules have not been confirmed as published official rules.
